mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) increases photosensitivity risk and may potentiate retinoid-induced skin irritation; both drugs can cause GI upset and piroxicam may reduce renal perfusion affecting tazarotene clearance.
action: Monitor for enhanced photosensitivity and dermatologic adverse effects; ensure adequate sun protection and consider alternative NSAID if significant skin irritation develops; maintain adequate hydration.
